messages:
maya: starting a short thread to propose an escrowed migration + automated preflight for customers moving off pinned models. goal: reduce manual billing work and make rollbacks predictable. draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/escrow-migrations (WIP)
maya: high-level pieces: 1) preflight checks (tokenizer/quant path/smoke runs), 2) escrow tiers & vesting, 3) automated canary pipeline + gating, 4) credit posting API + ledger events, 5) residency/contract checks and amendment template
jun: agree on automation. for credits we should support two surfaces: invoice-line release for enterprise, token credit for self-serve. both need an immutable ledger_event_id to reconcile.
arjun: ops note: migration-job service should own lifecycle. API idea: POST /migrations -> returns migration_id; then webhooks on phase transitions. tag metrics with migration_id so SRE can filter.
liam: CS/Legal note: enterprise customers want invoice line and an amendment. legal will also ask for a clear definition of "migration failure" and partial-failure handling.
billing-bot: for any apply-credit action we require: contract_id, approval_code, ledger_event_id, amount_cents, migration_id. response will include event_id and posted_at. idempotency_key required.
maya: proposed escrow tiers: Starter $1k, Growth $8k, Enterprise $40k. vesting: 40% at day 7, 60% at day 21. clawback if customer downgrades or cancels within 45 days. open to feedback.
jun: gating thresholds draft: canonical eval delta >= -0.15% and p95 latency <= baseline + 30ms for automatic promote. if only silver gates met, require CS sign-off.
arjun: runbook sketch: 
- PRE: preflight checks -> create escrow record with ledger_ref
- CANARY: 1% for 24h -> run evals -> gate check
- RAMP: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with checks at each step
- STABILIZE: 7d at 100% -> release escrow
- FAIL: rollback -> compute credit (partial/full) -> POST /credits/apply

liam: partial credit idea: if infra OK but quality delta between -0.15% and -0.5%, release 25% escrow and start remediation window. legal needs to approve template.
billing-bot: sample credit payload: {"migration_id":"M-123","contract_id":"C-456","approval_code":"AP-789","ledger_event_id":"LE-2026-001","amount_cents":800000,"type":"partial"} -> returns {"event_id":"EV-...","posted_at":"..."}. include idempotency_key.
maya: next steps: jun will spec precise thresholds + eval bundle, arjun will stub migration-job API and emit sample webhook payloads, liam will coordinate legal amendment template, billing-bot will produce API contract. i'll schedule a 20m sync Thu. update the doc, not the thread. :rocket:
